purpose: Determine whether detailed, lineage-labelled LEGACY-PY image descriptors distinguish T8 and T9 robustly across bounded pixel/slice resolutions after the frozen nine-scalar XRV1 summary collided.

known_before_new_execution.interpretation: The baseline is prior evidence, not a blinded observation. All convergence gates below are frozen before calculating the three new configurations.

fixed_image_contract.component_backend: OpenCV connectedComponentsWithStats; exact immutable LEGACY-PY behavior
fixed_image_contract.mask_rule: saved PNG readback before descriptor calculation
fixed_image_contract.artifact_rule: retain first/middle/last audit images; freeze tables/results/hashes; delete remaining transient PNGs with ledger

configuration_matrix.role: known frozen CINT-02 baseline; reuse only

candidate_scope.LEGACY-PY-RESULT: 24 slice values plus 6 thickness values; IP/LIP/LTP populations remain explicit
candidate_scope.LEGACY-PY-ANGLE-ALL: 10 global weighted summary values; never merged silently with LEGACY-PY-RESULT
candidate_scope.status_before_run: sensitivity rescue candidates; no XRV1 formula promotion

pre_registered_classification.robustly_distinguishing: symmetric relative difference >= 0.01 in all four configs, T8-T9 sign identical in all four, and max(relative difference)/min(relative difference) <= 2.0
pre_registered_classification.strongly_distinguishing: robustly_distinguishing plus relative difference >= 0.02 in at least three of four configs
pre_registered_classification.resolution_sensitive: baseline relative difference >= 0.01 but robustly_distinguishing gate fails
pre_registered_classification.weak_or_no_rescue: baseline relative difference < 0.01 and robustly_distinguishing gate fails
pre_registered_classification.zero_pair_exception: if both values are zero in any config, that config is non-distinguishing; if one is zero and one nonzero, relative difference is 2.0

allowed: identify traceable detailed descriptor candidates for later leakage-safe feature evaluation
authorize a separate axis rescue only if z-axis convergence fails
not_allowed: promote F009-F012 or any candidate to canonical formula
fit GM or any y model
use GM magnitude to rank candidates
change active roster or begin T5
